issues.issue: The statement Total-column line is split by fund column (General plus five nonmajor funds from pp11-12). The pieces are printed and add up exactly, but the rules take statement receipts from the Total column and allow fund-column splits only for tax-type pieces. The notes say this follows FY2023.

The asset side's 'Due from other funds' is Internal Balances, but the matching 'Due to other funds' liabilities (also liabilities[7]) are recorded as other liabilities. The categories are inconsistent.

The capital outlay rule wants 'Capital Outlay: <function>'. The Street line got Streets/Highways, but the General (43,997), Park (5,837, detail[69]) and Swimming Pool (12,793) capital outlay lines have no function, although the fund identifies it (general government, culture/recreation).

This is a mixed contributions/grants label (Statement of Activities: Operating Grants and Contributions). Schedule 7 (p15) prints the same 72,670 as 'Contributions', so donations is defensible. Note that Schedule 7 also relabels Contracts 89,750 as 'Contracts/grants'.
